# tissue_mast_channel (Data Source)

The deprecated name of the `tissue_mast_alert_source` data source. It takes the same arguments and reads the same thing.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the alert source or heartbeat.

### Read-Only

- `heartbeat` (Boolean) Whether it is a heartbeat.
- `id` (String) Its id, `mc_...`.
- `kind` (String) The API's word for what it is: `channel` for an alert source, or `vital` for a heartbeat.
- `policy_id` (String) The policy it follows, or empty.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) The ingest URL, key included.
